sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Exclusive: As wildfires rage, Frank Elderson says more work needed to assess risk from collapse of ecosystem services A senior policymaker at the European Central Bank has said the climate emergency and the breakdown of nature poses a dramatically growing risk to the global economy. Frank Elderson, a member of the ECB’s executive board, said the eurozone lender of last resort was stepping up its monitoring of the financial risks linked to the destruction of “ecosystem services”, which are nature-related processes or assets that support human activity. threads_text:
ECB官員警告氣候風險

歐洲央行（ECB）執行理事法蘭克·艾爾德森（Frank Elderson）警告，氣候危機與生態系統的崩壞，正對「核心金融穩定」構成日益升高的風險。他表示，歐洲央行正加強監測與「生態系統服務」（也就是支撐人類活動運作的自然機制與資源）崩壞相關的金融風險，這也顯示氣候議題正式進入央行的風險評估清單。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 2 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 歐洲央行的一位官員說，氣候風險現在也威脅到金融穩定了。他是法蘭克·艾爾德森，歐洲央行的執行理事。他說，氣候危機和生態系統的崩壞，正在對「核心金融穩定」構成愈來愈大的風險，央行也在加強監測這方面的影響。
